content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-E2..E4, REQ-J1 (queue UI)

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/api/queue/pending_auto_actions.rs
- polaris-backend/src/repo/pending_auto_actions.rs
- polaris-frontend/src/components/pending_auto_actions_queue.rs
- polaris-frontend/styles/pending-auto-actions-queue.css

**Endpoints**:
- GET /api/queue/pending-auto-actions (filtered by routing rules)
- POST /api/queue/pending-auto-actions/:id/approve (promotes to action; actor_kind='human')
- POST /api/queue/pending-auto-actions/:id/reject (records moderator reasoning; fires Feedback RPC)
- daily batch: expire rows older than 7 days (state → 'expired')

**Rust quality**:
- Repo: parameterized sqlx queries only
- Approve path: open a tx, insert action + citations from the draft snapshot, mark draft 'approved'
- Reject path: mark draft 'rejected' + reasoning + enqueue feedback call
- Frontend: BEM naming, tokens-only colours, contrast-passing pairings

**Tests**:
- tests/pending_auto_actions_endpoint.rs — approve creates action; reject fires feedback; expired drafts auto-marked

**Blocked by**: #LLM-3, #LLM-5
